body:
Friends in/around Portland OR – I hope you’ll join this amazing group of conversation partners for a unique interactive experience hosted by St. John’s Church and organized by offthemap.com. March 16th (9:30 am – 4 pm) … Shon Neyland, Randy Woodley, Michael Swanson, Edith Woodley, Linda Joe Devlaeminck, Fred Lynch, Ernestine Flemister, Diana Akiyama, Kafi Mashariki-Carrasco, Michelle Lang-Raymond, Paul Young, Deborah Loyd … and you, we hope!
